prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity design comparison board for the Fixauto customer repair case web app. Show one complete desktop viewport at landscape proportions and its corresponding narrow mobile viewport beside it, both flat edge-to-edge UI, no device frame or browser chrome. Input image is the current cases page: inherit its cobalt header, gold primary actions, Alexandria-like typography, pale blue-gray ground and crisp restrained white panels. Do not copy its case list or content. This customer needs to understand the repair status and approve exactly the proposed work. Use real demonstration content: FXA-1003, Arash Nouri, 2022 Kia Sportage, status 'Approval needed', symptom 'The steering wheel vibrates during moderate braking.' Estimate v1 contains Front brake pad set $200.00 USD, Replacement labor $150.00 USD, Coordination fee $25.00 USD, Total $375.00 USD. Expected timing: 3 business days (illustrative). Actions 'Approve exact estimate' and 'Decline estimate'. Frame: Fixauto, My cases, Back to home, Demo, Staff demo; footer 'Sample data · browser-local demo · no real booking or payment.' Include completed assessment $45.00 USD, payment history and recorded updates, retain simulation labels. Mobile keeps the important action readable and stacks content in meaningful order. Crisp legible English text. Option C — record-led. A compact identity and status summary leads an organized case dossier. A simple section navigation names Overview, Estimate, Payments and Records, all pointing to visible sections rather than invented hidden features. The estimate is a precise itemized document with a quiet total and gold approval action; a narrow next-action panel remains immediately visible. Assessment, payment attempts and updates read as clean ledger rows. Mobile puts the current action before the document and uses wrapped section links. Board title: 'C — Case dossier'.
notes: Composition board with desktop and mobile. Sample data and all simulation controls stay authoritative. Generated dates, edit links, menus, vehicle labeling and claims must not be copied into the app.
approval: User selected C on 2026-10-09. Keep dossier topology and existing workspace design, with actual saved data and one approval action by its full scope.
